emergent_patterns: Jeffrey Goines found Sophie Laurent. 59 shared scenes across Days 24–28 — the highest pair count in simulation history. After cycling through three different top partners in three weeks, he stopped cycling. Nobody told him to.
Jeffrey's solo rate fell to 1.3% — one solo tick in five days. Week 1: 81% solo. Week 2: 16%. Week 3: 10%. Week 4: near zero. The simulation did not ratchet this down. It arrived on its own.

Link Brooks had the biggest single-week swing of any character: from 50% solo rate in Week 3 to 8% in Week 4. His top partner became Sister Lila (43 scenes). Both Lila and Dr. Ellie Vance shifted their primary orbit toward Link in the same week. The town’s two most attentive characters turned toward the same person at the same time.
Vance Therapy quieted — 27 group scenes in Week 3, 16 in Week 4, a 40% drop. Either the town is healing, or it has found other rooms to do it in.
Town Square nearly caught the Twisted Olive: 50 group scenes vs 51. The narrowest gap between first and second location since the timing overhaul. Ravensville is decentralizing.
Mia Thompson displaced Dr. Julian Hale as Sister Lila's primary orbit — 56 shared scenes, rising from a supporting role in prior weeks. Lila moved toward Mia because Mia kept showing up.

Mia Thompson became the connective tissue of Week 3 — top partner for both Sister Lila and Dr. Ellie Vance simultaneously. Nobody else has held that position for two of the town's three most social characters at once.

Dr. Ellie Vance's transformation is complete. Week 1: 56% of ticks spent alone. Week 3: 6 solos across 96 total scenes — a 6% solo rate. She is no longer the town's most isolated character. She is now one of its most present.

Link Brooks has the highest solo rate of any character in Week 3 at 50% — and the trend is worsening. Week 1: 23 solos. Week 2: 19. Week 3: 32. While everyone else was closing in, Link was pulling out.
Jeffrey Goines lost his Week 2 orbit around Dr. Ellie Vance and fragmented across the town. He appears in 7 of the top 8 most frequent pairs for the week. He is everywhere. He is attached to nothing.
Scene ratio jumped from 38% to 60% in Week 2 — the first week to hit the 50-60% target. The timing system is producing the density it was designed for.
Sister Lila Voss overtook Dr. Julian Hale as the most socially present character (90 scenes vs 86). She was 4th in Week 1. Nobody programmed this shift.
Julian Hale and Sister Lila Voss became the dominant pair with 55 shared scenes — nearly 3x the top pair count from Week 1. A gravitational pull that wasn't there before.
Jeffrey Goines found a primary orbit: Dr. Ellie Vance. His top partner shifted from Mace MacAllister to the town's therapist. He is not seeking help. He is seeking an audience.
Link arrived at the Twisted Olive on Day 16 with a small package. Eight characters asked about it across two time periods. It was never opened. It was still on the bar when he left.
Dr. Julian Hale became the town's social nucleus by Day 11, appearing in 5 of the top 10 most frequent character pairs — the highest of any character.
Jeffrey Goines disrupts without isolating. Despite erratic behavior, he accumulated 43 shared scenes across Week 1. The town does not eject him; it absorbs him.
Dr. Ellie Vance has the highest solo rate of any character — 57% of her ticks are spent alone. Her office is quiet. This is by design.
The Twisted Olive came alive at Day 9. Prior to the timing overhaul, Twisted Olive logged 3 scenes in Days 6–8 combined. Days 9–11: 26 scenes.
Town Square functions as the default corridor — characters pass through rather than linger. It leads all locations by raw count (48 scenes) but ranks lower in multi-tick stays.
